not_covered: stops moved by a ladder exit plan are not snapped or checked
trailed stops are snapped by the engine but only the initial stop of each trade is checked
targets are market exits in production and are not orders
broker acceptance of a trigger is a pre-live operational check and is not part of this evidence
the dated tick reference is verified against the NSE circulars for the 2024 and 2025 changes; the Rs 0.05 tick before 2024-06-10 is primary-confirmed only as of May 2024 (see its header)
rule: every stop trigger is a multiple of the exact tick tier of its month, taken from the previous month's last close restated for corporate actions into the trade session's price units (safe_tick of the stop where that month is not in the data)
